title: Nothing may stop a compaction and nothing is lost: watchers pause themselves, a system message counts down 5 seconds, wake signals queue and replay
text: Owner, chat 2026-10-10 ~19:50 UTC: monitoring must not trip the compact; smart on and off with automation, a system message and a 5 second countdown, nothing allowed to stop the compact, nothing lost, every agent uses this. Design: the guard writes quiet.json for the seat before the countdown; every watcher and the monitor seat hold delivery while it exists and write wake signals to the seat's inbox queue (one file per signal, UTC named); the guard posts COMPACTION IN 5 into the pane, counts down, types /compact; PostCompact removes quiet.json, watchers resume, the inbox drains oldest first into the first turn. In a Claude Code seat today the equivalent is TaskStop on every Monitor before the compact and re-arm after.
